reasons.sideConditional: Shared init registers optional side-only modules behind IsDuplicityVersion control flow or the existing nil-module no-op. LuaLS does not evaluate the runtime-side guard.
reasons.providerAlternative: Mutually exclusive provider adapters implement the same domain methods. Resolver tests cover selection/isolation; static global table merging sees alternative definitions.
reasons.legacyAnnotation: Existing LuaDoc parameter or optional/tuple return annotations are narrower than the supported runtime contract. Retained as annotation debt; no runtime behavior is changed to satisfy these types.
reasons.guardedConversion: A documented identifier/slot/price is coerced or cleared, and the existing guard/provider checks establish availability. LuaLS retains the pre-coercion annotation or cannot narrow a custom predicate.
reasons.callableGuard: The resolver checks functions and CFX/metatable callables explicitly before calling. LuaLS cannot narrow the dynamic export/funcref union.
reasons.initializedSlots: slots[key] is initialized before the per-source assignment; LuaLS loses that relation across the dynamic key.
reasons.legacyLuaArity: Extra arguments to this ordinary Lua function are intentionally ignored; optional metadata arguments are intentionally omitted and handled as nil. These are not native argument mismatches.
reasons.dormantScaleform: The placer scaleform state is initialized/reset to nil and setup is disabled. This cleanup branch is dormant; no removed scaleform facade is restored.
